title: C2: Every conclusion fails for some nonnegative matrix
title_html: C2: Every conclusion fails for some nonnegative matrix
html: For each part of @thm-perron, (a) to (d), give a nonnegative 2×2 matrix for which that part fails, and name the step of the proof that breaks. Then give a nonnegative matrix for which (a), (b) and (c) fail at the same time.
